rightsized_derivation.dominant_savings_lever: Move the 634 omics.m.large tasks (mostly snv:clairs_extract_candidates, ~11% memory efficiency) to omics.c.large (2 CPU, 4 GiB) -> ~$0.279/run. Secondary: right-size pileup_variants c.xlarge->c.large and the smallest modkit shards.

conservative_as_run.description: Observed per-run compute+storage cost x 150, using the run exactly as configured (tuned v1.5.1). No right-sizing applied.

optimized.description: Applies the performance-report right-sizing recommendations (drop the m.large ClairS bucket to c.large, pileup_variants to c.large, trim modkit). Also assumes finer SNV sharding removes the evaluate_candidates straggler runway and a spot-instance tumor merge; those two are qualitative wall-clock/pre-step savings not folded into the per-run HealthOmics compute number.

notes: CANCELLED-RUN CAVEAT: run 3295679 was operator-cancelled after completing essentially the whole pipeline EXCEPT one straggler snv:evaluate_candidates shard (#341) plus the downstream SNV merge/annotation tail. The observed $5.4552/run therefore SLIGHTLY UNDER-ESTIMATES a fully-completed run - the unfinished full-alignment shard and the final merge/gather steps are not billed here. Treat both projections as a lower bound on a 100%-complete run.

The ~292 GB tumor BAM merge (samtools merge of PAU59949 + PAU61426) is a REQUIRED per-pair HealthOmics pre-step because wf-somatic-variation v1.5.1 main.nf does file(bam_tumor).exists() and needs a single file; HealthOmics cannot stage S3 directory or glob URIs. For 150 pairs this merge should run on SPOT EC2 (e.g. m6i/m7i 2xlarge) to minimise cost; it is NOT part of the HealthOmics run cost above and must be budgeted separately (roughly one ~30-60 min spot instance per pair).

The evaluate_candidates straggler needs FINER REGION SHARDING, not more CPU. Measured pileup_variants CPU efficiency at the tuned 4-CPU allocation was 4-25% (max ~1 core used), so more cores per shard waste money. The critical-path fix is splitting pathological full-alignment intervals into smaller chunks.

Assumptions: no re-run overhead, no cross-AZ / cross-region data-transfer premium beyond ap-southeast-1 defaults, no long-term storage tail beyond the outputs bucket, single-region pricing at analysis time (no committed-use discounts or credits applied).
A run cache (id 6598859, CACHE_ALWAYS) is attached; production re-runs that reuse completed tasks would cost less than these projections.
Storage cost for DYNAMIC can be under-estimated for short (<1h) runs; this run was 8.5h so the storage figure is representative.

Per-run cost is small (~$5.5) because ClairS shards run on inexpensive omics.m.large / omics.c.xlarge instances; the dominant cost centres are sv:severus ($0.66) and the 631 clairs_extract_candidates shards ($2.43 aggregate).
